_what: The words of the Add pages picker on Connections (src/workspace/add-pages.tsx, placed by `section` in src/account-screens.mjs): the pages (screens) this account is offered, from the Marketplace catalogue and the app's own, each added to one of the person's sidebar lists. `read` is where the lists and every row a list can hold are read (src/sidebar.mjs read) and `change` where an add is sent (the same verb change_sidebar takes). `shown_most` bounds how many matching rows are drawn at once.

section.heading: Add pages
section.body: Pages from the Marketplace and your own apps. Choose a list and add a page to it; it shows in your sidebar at once.

words.no_lists: You have no sidebar lists to add to yet. Make one from the sidebar's Add a list.
words.more: Showing the first {count}. Search to narrow them.
words.not_added: That page was not added. Try again.
